打開瓶蓋，壓力變小，氣泡就跑出來
溫度越高，氣泡跑得越快
ask_back: 打開汽水瓶，你猜會有聲音嗎？

question_patterns: where do the bubbles come from
en.first_sentence: This is soda! Gas is pushed in, so it fizzes and bubbles.
facts: Soda has lots of the gas that makes bubbles in it.
When you open the cap, the push gets smaller and bubbles come out.
Warm soda loses its bubbles faster than cold soda.
en.ask_back: Do you think soda stays fizzy longer in the fridge, or on the table?

bridges.has_sibling: Do you and your brother or sister race to drink soda?
